subject: Insurance
title: Stranger-Originated Life Insurance
description: A fast breakdown of Stranger-Originated Life Insurance for builders.

hook.text: Investors pay elderly strangers' premiums in exchange for the death benefit. When the stranger dies, investors cash in.

buildup.text: STOLI schemes target seniors: 'We'll pay your premiums, you sign the policy, and investors collect when you pass away.'

discovery.text: The insured person gets a small upfront payment. Investors get a potentially massive return on a short-term bet.

twist.text: Courts ruled STOLI violates insurable interest laws. You can't insure someone you have no relationship with.

climax.text: STOLI turned life insurance into a death bet.

punchline.text: Bet on a stranger's death, collect the payout. Courts shut STOLI down.

quiz.question: Why were STOLI schemes ruled illegal?
